message: The other day, as the skies darkened and the wind picked up, I found myself explaining to my grandkids why we should gather some snacks and flashlights. They looked at me like I was suggesting we build a spaceship. After a few rounds of 'But why?' I just shrugged and said, 'Because storms don't care about our snack choices.' Sometimes, preparedness is just a way to outsmart the weather and keep the kids entertained. How do you handle storm prep with your little ones?
